scope: SKYCloud 整改最终验收清单：原分析问题、工程建议与当前整改项一一对应，含实现、证据、剩余任务与完成标准

workstreams.goal: 最终验收清单：原分析问题、工程建议与整改项逐项对应，含实现、证据、剩余任务与完成标准
Runtime 生命周期与故障恢复：创建/替换/启停/重启/账号删除/权限撤销并发，远端已接受但 SQL 失败或进程崩溃的恢复，重复请求、失联、旧实例退休与孤立资源回收
下载、iframe 与权限链路：查询 JWT 移除后的替代流程（下载、图片、SSE、Runtime iframe、终端、短期票据）及过期/重放/退出/改密/移除/降级/替换
异步 I/O 与资源所有权：异步入口中的 DB/存储/Controller/LLM/MQ/本地文件操作，工作线程 Session 所有权，流/连接/临时文件关闭与取消
错误处理与 API 契约：REST/SSE/MCP/后台任务/Controller 异常路径，凭据/SQL 参数/文件内容不泄漏，失败不得记为成功
Service/Repository/外部 Client 边界：File、MCP、Workspace/Runtime、Assistant/Expert、Chat 的持久化与外部资源拆分
完整后端类型检查：212 个生产源码文件零诊断，随后启用 CI 门禁
前端与真实浏览器验证：认证、路由守卫、API 包装、上传、文件操作、Workspace 权限、Assistant 状态与浏览器全流程
集成验证与部署检查：PostgreSQL/vector、事务锁、迁移回滚、Redis、RabbitMQ、MinIO、Docker、全新部署与历史库升级
CI、远端交付与最终验收：后端/前端/集成/Compose/镜像/类型检查汇总，推送与分支保护（待授权）

items.requirement: Keep provider secrets in backend; scoped expiring runtime LLM tokens, allowed model and quotas
implementation: Runtime receives only a model-only JWT; provider key stays in independent llm-gateway process. Hash persistence reuses revocable runtime records.
JWT binds user/workspace/runtime/model and maximum one-hour expiry; gateway checks current runtime state and editor membership, rejects REST/MCP credentials and alternate models.

items.requirement: Separate runtimes from database, cache, queue and object storage; restrict egress
implementation: Dedicated internal runtime network; API and DB/Redis/MQ/MinIO never join it. Controller relays application traffic from separate control network.
Real tests prove Runtime cannot reach infrastructure by DNS/direct IP, bridge can, and Controller management socket is unreachable from Runtime network even with correct credentials.

items.requirement: Remove Docker socket from API; authenticated restricted controller
implementation: Standalone authenticated Controller is the sole Docker socket owner. Only fixed pinned image, positive identities, managed labeled containers, internal network and sandbox options are accepted; no caller-selected Docker options or arbitrary exec API.

API uses scoped RPC and bounded authenticated HTTP/SSE relay, leaves runtime network. Controller binds only its separate control-network interface; Runtime cannot reach management API even with its token.

items.requirement: Reject passwords in profile update; require dedicated password change
implementation: Profile schema forbids extra fields; service permits only username/avatar; dedicated password service retains old-password checks
HTTP regression tests reject password profile mutation and preserve stored credentials

items.requirement: Fail closed on default secrets; explicit administrator bootstrap
implementation: Removed fixed JWT signing-key fallback; missing/short/placeholder secrets fail closed. OpenCode server derivation requires independent configured secret.
Private exclusive env generator creates six independent random secrets, mode 0600; Compose rejects missing infrastructure/Controller credentials.

items.requirement: Production infrastructure internal; development overrides
implementation: Production compose publishes frontend only. Explicit development override binds all administrative service ports to 127.0.0.1.
MCP accessed via frontend /mcp; frontend endpoint changed to same origin and nginx streaming proxy added.

items.requirement: Streaming file limits, user/workspace capacity, daily rate, multipart reservations and concurrency
implementation: Positive finite defaults: file 256 MiB, avatar 5 MiB, request 512 MiB, part 64 MiB. Nginx body limit is finite; actual container nginx -t passed. Invalid/zero/negative upload configurations fail closed.

ASGI middleware counts actual request bytes before multipart parsing, handles missing Content-Length, returns 413 and closes already-open multipart spools. HTTP, Base64, and Werkzeug adapters bound writes; Base64 encoded size is checked before decoding. Single/batch/part/assembly paths preserve 413 and clean incomplete temporary files.

items.requirement: Remove URL JWT; authenticated downloads and scoped short lived iframe tickets
implementation: REST credentials and workspace context read only Authorization Bearer. Signed query JWT and generic cookies are rejected. Downloads and protected Markdown/raw HTML images use authenticated Blob requests; historical URLs are normalized and object URLs released. SSE already uses Authorization headers.

Workspace iframe now requests a one-use 30-second opaque ticket, never a Web JWT URL. Redis stores only hash-derived credential keys. Redemption creates a host-only HttpOnly Strict session capped at ten minutes; HTTPS uses a Secure __Host- cookie. Each runtime has a distinct hostname, separate from the parent origin and other runtimes.

items.requirement: Alembic versioned schema upgrades; startup version check without DDL
implementation: Alembic baseline uses immutable schema SQL snapshot, adopts unversioned databases, repairs known legacy columns; second revision repairs file/chunk cosine vector indexes. No live ORM create_all in migration revisions.

Explicit entry.migrate / standard Alembic upgrade supported. PostgreSQL advisory transaction lock serializes concurrent migration processes, lock timeout bounds waits, all DDL/revision updates roll back atomically on failure. Destructive baseline downgrade is rejected.

items.requirement: Remove synchronous IO from event loop paths
implementation: Async LLM chat/embedding accounting executes database writes in threads; chat stream usage recording also offloaded.
Async Redis cacheable/cache_evict/cache_put read/write/evict moved to threads. Behavior tests hold slow accounting/Redis operations and prove event loop stays available.

items.requirement: Invalidate previous web sessions on password change
implementation: Added users.auth_version via versioned migration 0003_auth_version. Login signs version into Web JWT; REST and MCP Web-session validation check authoritative scalar database version, bypassing profile caches and ORM identity state. Missing/noninteger/negative/mismatched versions rejected, unknown scopes denied.

Password changes lock and refresh the account row, validate old password for nonadmins, increment version and revoke external MCP and all Runtime credentials in the same transaction. Administrator reset affects target only.

items.requirement: Store only token hash; reveal raw token once and update client flow
implementation: Removed token_value from ORM and persistence. All external MCP tokens store only SHA-256 hashes and hash-derived fingerprints; even short compatibility credentials cannot leak through previews.

GET /auth/mcp-token returns metadata only, does not issue a credential; login/registration no longer auto-issue discarded external MCP tokens. POST refresh reveals the new raw credential once and sends Cache-Control: no-store.

items.requirement: Non-root runtime, drop capabilities, no privilege escalation, PID and disk limits
implementation: Actual _create uses UID 10001, read-only rootfs, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, PID 128, CPU and memory caps.
Bounded tmpfs: home 256 MiB, workspace 512 MiB, /tmp 64 MiB. No host volume or Docker socket supplied to runtime.

items.requirement: Memory access token and HttpOnly refresh cookie; strict CSP

verified_cache_semantics.finding: Cache correctness after mutations/permission changes is fenced transactionally, not by best-effort deletes.
mechanisms: Migration 0018: files trigger bumps workspaces.search_cache_revision, so every cached search key embeds a revision that changed with the write.
Migration 0019: users/sys_dict/folder/files triggers bump sql_cache_revisions rows (user:profile:<id>, sys_dict:all, workspace:tree:<ws>) in the same transaction.
Profile/list/detail cache keys embed the durable revision, so a prepared-then-revoked member cannot read a stale cached payload (verified by the real-PostgreSQL workspace-insight suites).
residual: The legacy literal-key evictions (folder service evict_cache of 'workspace:folders:<id>' and the organizer's clear_workspace_cache) are no-ops under the revision scheme: dead weight, not a correctness risk.
REST folder CRUD and the organizer toolset still implement duplicate-name validation twice; the real-PostgreSQL suites show identical outcomes, so this is maintainability-only.
